tytul: Akcje serwisowe aut w UE – tydzień 44/2026: Volkswagen, Lexus, KTM, Audi
lead: Wezwania samochodów do serwisu zgłoszone w unijnym systemie Safety Gate w 44. tygodniu 2026 r. – 7 pozycji.
tresc:
## Do uzupełnienia

Szkic bez tekstu – brak klucza modelu językowego. Opisy usterek poniżej są po angielsku: przetłumacz je w panelu przed publikacją.

zrodla.nazwa: Safety Gate – raport tygodniowy Report-2026-44 (Komisja Europejska)

pozycje.problem: Moisture ingress could lead to corrosion of a steering rack bolt, which may result in a fracture of the bolt and a loss of steering capability, increasing the risk of accidents. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 22/10/2026

pozycje.problem: An error during start-up of the 7-inch instrument panel may cause parts of the display to remain blank. As a result, warning indicators for engine oil pressure, engine coolant temperature and the charging system may not be displayed, preventing the driver from being alerted to these conditions and increasing the risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 20/10/2026

pozycje.problem: The screw connection of the steering damper may come loose, causing the steering damper to slip out of its bracket and lock the steering. This could lead to a loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 21/10/2026

pozycje.problem: The propellant in the driver and front passenger airbags may deteriorate over time. If the airbags deploy, it could result in fragments from the inflator injuring the vehicle's occupants. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 08/10/2026

pozycje.problem: With a high state of charge, overheating may occur inside the high-voltage battery and increase the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ImporterCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 26/10/2026
